text: In the past several months I would often use ChatGPT and Gemini to find local businesses that could use a new website. I tried many approaches and smart opinionated prompts. The results were small and mediocre. Last night I did the same with Grok @bot and it found 50 very strong leads and drafted emails to each. Those emails need my touch in rewriting but the leads are exactly what I'm looking for. This is a good use case for Grok Bot.
